summary: Atmos Energy Corp filed a preliminary prospectus supplement under Rule 424(b)(5) for an offering of senior notes with principal amount, coupon, and maturity left blank. The notes are unsecured senior obligations ranking pari passu with existing unsubordinated debt, issued in minimum denominations of $2,000, redeemable at Atmos's option, and will not be listed on any exchange. Joint book-running managers are BNP Paribas, Credit Agricole CIB, and US Bancorp. Proceeds are for general corporate purposes. This is a routine debt shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch only for final pricing, size, and coupon.
